entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`itemUrl` TEXT NOT NULL, `itemTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, `content` TEXT NOT NULL, `timestamp` INTEGER NOT NULL, `supabase_id` TEXT DEFAULT '', `created_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `updated_at` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_deleted` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `is_dirty` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(`itemUrl`))
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`content` TEXT NOT NULL, `itemTitle` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`notes`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `notes` BEGIN DELETE FROM `notes_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `notes` BEGIN DELETE FROM `notes_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `notes` BEGIN INSERT INTO `notes_fts`(`docid`, `content`, `itemTitle`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`content`, NEW.`itemTitle`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_notes_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `notes` BEGIN INSERT INTO `notes_fts`(`docid`, `content`, `itemTitle`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`content`, NEW.`itemTitle`); END
